triage.kind_span: issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4.

security_class.span: Common Stock, Par Value $0.0001 per share

price_basis.span: The offer is for cash at a purchase price equal to $6.00 per Share

size_shares.span: an offer by the Company to purchase, as approved by the Company’s board of directors (the “ Board ” ), 400,000 shares of its issued and outstanding common stock

commencement_date.span: The Offer period will begin March 19, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Pacific Time, on April 19, 2021, unless extended.

proration.span: If the amount of repurchase requests exceeds the number of Shares we seek to repurchase, we will repurchase Shares on a pro rata basis.

spans: material legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened which challenges, in the Board’s judgment, the Offer or otherwise materially adversely affects the Company
declaration of a banking moratorium by federal, state or foreign authorities or any suspension of payment by banks in the United States
other event or condition that, in the Board’s judgment, would have a material adverse effect on the Company or its Stockholders if Shares tendered pursuant to the Offer were purchased

trigger_origin.span: an offer by the Company to purchase, as approved by the Company’s board of directors

notes: Initial Schedule TO-I for an unlisted REIT (formerly a BDC) offering to buy 400,000 shares at a fixed $6.00 per share against a stated Estimated Per-Share NAV of $9.84 (39% below NAV; board recommends AGAINST tendering). price_pct_nav left null because the filing states a fixed dollar price and a '39% lower' figure, not a percent-of-NAV price. Offer is not conditioned on a minimum number of shares tendered. Shares are not traded on an established market (no ticker). Section 3 conditions also include a violation-of-law condition, banking moratorium, credit limitation, war/hostilities; mapped to legal_injunction, market_disruption and board_discretion. size_pct_outstanding not stated (13,362,419.23 shares outstanding stated; percent would need arithmetic). doc_seq of commencement span is 5 (Notice of Offer to Shareholders).
